sources.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash API model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact ID gemini-3.7-flash; 1,048,576-token input; text/image/video/audio/PDF input and text output; thinking and function calling supported. Documentation updated October 12, 2026 says the deprecated ID now routes to 3.8 Flash. Reopened October 27, 2026: the exact model specification table contains no numerical total or active parameter count.

sources.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 review of the original HTML card and complete nine-page PDF. Model dependencies and Architecture both explicitly identify Gemini 3.6 Flash as the base. No numerical total, active count, expert dimensions or routing width is disclosed. The original benchmark and safety tables report performance and pricing, without a parameter-size column.

sources.title: Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash
sources.evidence: Dated August 13, 2026; announces the model that day and gives immediate developer access through Gemini API and Google AI Studio. Identifies it as a Flash-series model from the Gemini team. Reopened October 27, 2026: the original launch describes capability and efficiency improvements without numerical model size.

sources.title: Gemini 3.6 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 review of the complete original PDF. Model dependencies explicitly identifies Gemini 3.5 Flash as the base, and Architecture refers to its card. This named base has no published total or activated count here.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 review of the complete original PDF. The model dependency explicitly names Gemini 3 Flash; the architecture reference follows that same base. No numerical total or active count is provided.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 complete-card review. Model dependencies and Architecture explicitly name Gemini 3 Pro as the base; no numeric total or active count is given for the Flash model.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro model card, updated May 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 complete-card review. Gemini 3 Pro is a sparse MoE Transformer, with qualitative token routing but no numerical total, active count or expert dimensions. It is explicitly not a modification or fine-tune of a prior model. The named dependency chain for 3.7 Flash therefore reaches no count-bearing base.

sources.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 complete-card review. The September 2026 model explicitly names Gemini 3.7 Flash as its base and includes an exact 3.7 Flash comparison column. The tables contain pricing, benchmark and safety results, with no total or activated-parameter size.

sources.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash Frontier Safety Framework Report
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full-text review of the complete August 2026 exact-model Frontier Safety Framework report. It describes SFT, RLHF, safeguards, evaluations and internal activations, but supplies no numerical total, active parameter count or dimensions from which to establish one. Safety probe activations are not parameter-count disclosures.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Service terms, effective March 23, 2026, govern Gemini API access and restrict extracting or replicating the underlying models and weights. Supports proprietary classification for the API-distributed model; page-content licenses are not model-weight licenses.

sources.title: Gemini API release notes
sources.evidence: August 13, 2026 section records GA release of gemini-3.7-flash. October 8 section records its deprecation and automatic routing to gemini-3.8-flash.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 complete decoded October 2026 card review. Argon is explicitly a new model rather than a modification or fine-tune of a prior one. Its architecture and benchmark tables provide no retrospective total or active size for Gemini 3.7 Flash.

sources.title: Developer's guide to Gemini 3.7 Flash
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-model search located this current guide, opened October 27. Its exact 3.7 Flash / 3.6 Flash / 3.1 Pro specification comparison lists context, modalities, thinking and deployment properties without numerical total or active size. Other parameter mentions concern API controls such as sampling and thinking settings, not learned weights.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Safety & Security Report
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full-text exact-name and parameter review. Multiple retrospective 3.7 Flash comparisons concern safety and capability scores, not model size. Parameter mentions concern evaluation difficulty, weight security and parametric knowledge; no numerical total or active count is supplied.

name.note: Exact named model and stable API identifier; distinct from the replacement 3.8 Flash.

developer.note: Google announcement and Google DeepMind model card establish developer ownership.

family.note: Normalized catalog key for the officially identified Gemini Flash series within Gemini 3.

release_date.note: Launch announcement and API GA release notes agree on this day, rather than a later regional listing or deprecation date.

open_weights.note: Official distribution is hosted products/APIs under restrictive service terms; no downloadable checkpoint or open weight license is offered in the model distribution documentation.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the Google service terms governing this model, not an SPDX weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-name/ID total-size and named-base searches, original cards/API/launch and later Google comparisons found no supported nominal total. The explicit 3.7 Flash to 3.6 Flash to 3.5 Flash to 3 Flash to 3 Pro chain is valid lineage evidence, but no named base publishes a numerical count. Null reflects absent count evidence, not an exact tensor-census requirement.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 active/activated-count searches and original/later primary comparison checks found no numerical active size. Sparse routing is qualitative, with no expert sizes or routing quantities sufficient for a count. Named bases also lack an active disclosure. API controls, safety activations, benchmark scores and throughput do not establish parameters activated per token.

architecture.note: Official Architecture references form the explicit chain 3.7 Flash -> 3.6 Flash -> 3.5 Flash -> 3 Flash -> 3 Pro, ending in sparse MoE Transformer. This verifies the broad architecture only; dimensions and expert counts remain undisclosed.

context_window.note: Exact documented input token limit for the historical 3.7 endpoint; current requests to this ID are redirected.

modalities.note: Exact model property table lists these supported input types and text-only output.

reasoning.note: Thinking is supported at low, medium and high levels.

description.value: Gemini 3-series model with text, image, video, audio and PDF input, text output, configurable thinking, and function calling.
description.note: Uses the exact API capability table instead of generic efficiency or workflow claims.

patch.description: Gemini 3-series model with text, image, video, audio and PDF input, text output, configurable thinking, and function calling.
patch.notes: Sparse MoE Transformer based on Gemini 3.6 Flash, through an explicit lineage to Gemini 3 Pro. Total and active parameter counts are undisclosed for this model and its named bases. Google deprecated gemini-3.7-flash on October 8, 2026 and routes this ID to gemini-3.8-flash; listed capabilities describe the original 3.7 Flash model.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit: total and active counts remain explicitly null after fresh exact-model searches, original card/PDF/API and safety-report checks, named-base review and later Google comparisons. The explicit dependency chain is valid, but no count-bearing base was found. New Cloud comparison and Gemini 4 safety evidence provide no retrospective numerical size. All unrelated audited fields are preserved.
